64719.de: A female figure decorating the lid of a goblet holds a shield depicting symbols of locksmiths and other fine-metalworking trades: a padlock, spurs, pistols, etc. The flag that was in the figure's other hand belongs to the Tallinn City Museum (inv. no. TLM 4290)

66658.d:
Pottsepasellide tervituspokaal
Tüveks valatud putofiguur, mis hoiab pea kohal kahe käega kuppa?
Kaanel oleval puto täisfiguuril  käes S-kujulisele kilbile graveeirutd nimi: Christofer Schiller altgesell.
Karikas ilusa läbikaalutud profiiliga ning ning üleni kaetud peene graveeritud ornamendiga. Ornamendi vahel üleval ja all graveeritud nimed: And. Behlau, Gottf. Hackner, George Marscevskij ? Meister, Martin Wohmann Schreiber, George H: Buntzler, Peter Lithau, Johann Böhmer, Johann Lasenhöfner. Keskel: Carl G. Kürtzer, Johann C; Ernst D; Christian Johann A; Jacob F. Müller; Herman S. Alumine rida: Gottfried Hertzog, Johan Starck, Caspar P: Gröbler, Christian Gottbrecht, Anton Fitich, Christia
66658.de:
Potters' journeymen's welcome goblet
A putto figure cast as the stem, holding a cup above its head with both hands?
On the lid, a full figure of a putto holding an S-shaped shield engraved with the name: Christofer Schiller altgesell.
The goblet has a beautifully balanced profile and is entirely covered with fine engraved ornamentation. Between the ornamentation, at the top and bottom, are engraved names: And. Behlau, Gottf. Hackner, George Marscevskij ? Meister, Martin Wohmann Schreiber, George H: Buntzler, Peter Lithau, Johann Böhmer, Johann Lasenhöfner. In the middle: Carl G. Kürtzer, Johann C; Ernst D; Christian Johann A; Jacob F. Müller; Herman S. Bottom row: Gottfried Hertzog, Johan Starck, Caspar P: Gröbler, Christian Gottbrecht, Anton Fitich, Christia
